CityPage.metaDescription: Current local time in {city}, {country} — {offset} ({abbreviation}). Daylight saving info, sunrise & sunset, time difference with major cities, weather, currency, and flight estimates.
CityPage.heading: What time is it in {city}?
CityPage.dstNotObserved: {city} does not observe daylight saving time — it stays at {offset} all year round.
CityPage.meetingSubtitle: Overlap between {city}'s and each city's standard 9:00-18:00 workday.
CityPage.faqQ1: What time is it in {city} right now?
CityPage.faqA2No: No — {city} does not observe daylight saving time; it stays at {offset} all year.
CityPage.faqQ3: What is the time difference between {city} and {refCity}?
CityPage.faqA3Same: {city} and {refCity} are in the same time zone.
CityPage.faqQ4: What is the UTC offset in {city}?
CityPage.faqQ5: When is sunrise and sunset in {city} today?
CityPage.faqA5: Sunrise is at {sunrise} and sunset at {sunset} in {city} today.
CityPage.faqA5Midnight: The sun does not set in {city} today — it's midnight sun season.
CityPage.faqA5Polar: The sun does not rise in {city} today — it's polar night.
CityPage.narrativeOffsetConstant: {city} is {hours}h {minutes}min {direction, select, ahead {ahead of} behind {behind} other {ahead of}} {refCity} and does not observe daylight saving time, so this difference stays constant all year round — unlike {contrastCity}, which changes clocks twice a year.
CityPage.narrativeOffsetVaries: {city} is currently {hours}h {minutes}min {direction, select, ahead {ahead of} behind {behind} other {ahead of}} {refCity}. Because {city} observes daylight saving time, this gap shifts by about an hour twice a year.
CityPage.narrativeDstAbolished: {city} abolished daylight saving time in 2019; the timezone remains at {offset} all year round.
CityPage.narrativeMidnightSun: Because {city} sits at {lat}° {hemisphere}, the sun does not set at all today — the midnight sun.
CityPage.narrativePolarNight: Because {city} sits at {lat}° {hemisphere}, the sun does not rise at all today — polar night.
CityPage.narrativeHalfHourOffset: {city} uses a {minutesPart}-minute offset ({offset}) instead of a whole hour — like a handful of countries, including India and Nepal, that split the difference between whole-hour zones.
CityPage.narrativeChinaSpecial: {city} is officially on Beijing Time ({offset}), the single time zone mandated across all of China — even though the country spans roughly five geographic hour-widths.
CityPage.narrativeMultiZoneCountry: {country} spans {count} different time zones among the cities we track, so {city}'s local time can differ from other {country} cities.
CityPage.narrativeIslandNation: {country} is an island nation, so every city we track there shares {city}'s single time zone.
CityPage.narrativeSingleZoneCountry: Despite its geography, {country} keeps a single time zone nationwide, so every city we track there shares {city}'s offset.

Privacy.pageSubtitle: How World Time Zone handles data — in plain language.
Privacy.introP1: World Time Zone ("we", "this site") is a free time zone comparison tool. This policy explains what data the site collects, why, and the choices you have.
Privacy.noAccountP1: This site has no user accounts and no server-side database. We do not collect names, email addresses, or payment information, and we cannot identify you personally from anything the site stores.
Privacy.localStorageHeading: What we store in your browser
Privacy.localStorageP1: The site saves your preferences directly in your browser's local storage, never on our servers: the cities you're comparing, your reference date/time selection, time-format and theme choices, sunrise/sunset card settings, your custom navigation order, any city alarms or business-hours alerts you create on the Alerts page, and your cookie-consent choice.
Privacy.localStorageP2: This data stays on your device. Clearing your browser's site data (or using a different browser or device) removes it and resets the site to its defaults.
Privacy.cookiesP1: By itself, this site does not set any cookies. When you accept cookies through the banner, we store that choice in your browser (also as local storage, not a tracking cookie), and Google AdSense may then set its own cookies, described below.
Privacy.adsP1: We show ads through Google AdSense. AdSense and its partners may use cookies and similar technologies to serve ads, including personalized ads based on your browsing activity, and to measure ad performance.
Privacy.adsP2: These ads only load after you accept cookies in the consent banner. If you reject non-essential cookies, no AdSense script or ad cookie loads, and you'll see a plain placeholder instead. You can review Google's own practices at policies.google.com/technologies/ads and manage ad personalization at adssettings.google.com.
Privacy.analyticsP1: This site does not currently use Google Analytics or any other analytics or tracking service. If that changes in the future, this policy will be updated first.
Privacy.externalApisIntro: To show live information, the site queries these third-party services from your browser or from our own server on your behalf. No personal data is sent to them beyond the city or country names already visible in the app:
Privacy.externalApiWeather: Open-Meteo — current conditions and 7-day forecasts for the /weather page.
Privacy.externalApiCurrency: Frankfurter (European Central Bank reference rates) — exchange rates for the /currency page.
Privacy.externalApiNews: Google News RSS — local headlines for the /news page, fetched through our own server.
Privacy.externalApiMap: The world map on /map uses Natural Earth boundary data bundled with the site at build time — it is not fetched live and involves no external request.
Privacy.rightsIntro: If you're in Brazil, the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) applies; if you're in the European Economic Area or the UK, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applies. Because this site keeps almost everything in your own browser, most of these rights are already in your hands:
Privacy.rightsAccess: Access and portability: open your browser's developer tools (Application/Storage tab) to see exactly what's stored for this site.
Privacy.rightsDeletion: Deletion: clear your browser's site data for this domain, or use the in-app reset options, to erase everything instantly.
Privacy.rightsWithdraw: Withdraw consent: use "Cookie preferences" in the footer at any time to change or withdraw your cookie choice.
Privacy.rightsComplaint: Complaint: you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority (for example, the ANPD in Brazil, or your national supervisory authority in the EU/UK).
Privacy.revokeP1: Reopen the cookie banner at any time via the "Cookie preferences" link in the footer to accept or reject non-essential cookies again.
Privacy.contactP1: Questions about this policy can be sent to the contact address on our Contact page.
Privacy.changesP1: We may update this policy as the site evolves — for example, if we add analytics or new ad formats. We'll update the date above whenever we do.

Terms.pageSubtitle: The terms that apply when you use World Time Zone.
Terms.introP1: By using World Time Zone ("the site"), you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the site.
Terms.serviceP1: World Time Zone is a free tool for comparing time zones and related travel information — weather, currency, news, and flight-time estimates — for cities you choose. It has no paid tiers, accounts, or subscriptions at this time.
Terms.disclaimerP1: All information on this site — time zone offsets, daylight saving transitions, weather forecasts, currency exchange rates, news headlines, and especially flight price and duration estimates — is provided for general reference only and is not guaranteed to be accurate, complete, or current.
Terms.disclaimerFlights: Flight prices and durations shown on the /flights page are calculated from distance and date using a simple formula. They are not real fares or schedules from any airline, travel agency, or booking system. Never book travel, plan a connection, or make any time-sensitive decision based solely on these estimates — always confirm directly with the airline or an official source.
Terms.disclaimerOthers: Likewise, always double-check critical times, weather conditions, exchange rates, and news with an authoritative source before making decisions that matter — for example, before a business meeting, a flight, or a financial transaction.
Terms.noWarrantyP1: The site is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We don't guarantee the site will be uninterrupted, error-free, or free of inaccuracies from the third-party sources it relies on (Open-Meteo, Frankfurter/European Central Bank, Google News, and others).
Terms.liabilityP1: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of, or inability to use, this site — including missed flights, meetings, or financial loss resulting from reliance on information shown here.
Terms.ipP1: The site's design, code, and original content are owned by its operator. World map boundaries are derived from Natural Earth (public domain). Data from Open-Meteo, Frankfurter, and Google News remains the property of those respective providers and is used under their public terms.
Terms.acceptableUseP1: Don't use automated tools to overload the site or its underlying APIs, attempt to bypass security measures, or use the site for any unlawful purpose.
Terms.changesP1: We may revise these terms as the site evolves. Continuing to use the site after a revision means you accept the updated terms. We'll update the date above whenever we do.
Terms.contactP1: Questions about these terms can be sent to the contact address on our Contact page.

About.pageSubtitle: A free, no-login tool for comparing time zones and planning around the world.
About.introP1: World Time Zone helps you compare the local time in cities around the world side by side, find good meeting windows across time zones, and see related travel context — weather, currency, local news, and rough flight estimates — for the same cities, all in one place.
About.whoP1: Remote teams and freelancers coordinating meetings across time zones, people with friends or family abroad, and travelers planning a trip who want a quick overview of a destination's time, weather, and money before they dig deeper.
About.featureComparator: Time zone comparator — add any number of cities and see their current time, offset, and business-hours overlap.
About.featureChart: Chart view — hour-difference bars and a 24-hour overlap chart to find the best meeting window.
About.featureMap: Map view — a world map with a live day/night terminator.
About.featureSun: Sunrise & sunset — sunrise, sunset, twilight, golden hour, and moon phase per city.
About.featureAlerts: Alerts — optional browser notifications for DST changes, city alarms, and end-of-business-hours, all handled client-side.
About.featureWeather: Weather — current conditions and a 7-day forecast.
About.featureCurrency: Currency — exchange rates and a simple converter.
About.featureFlights: Flights — distance-based price and duration estimates (see the disclaimer on that page — these are not real fares).
About.dataOpenMeteo: Weather — Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com), a free, no-key weather API.
About.dataFrankfurter: Currency — Frankfurter (frankfurter.dev), serving European Central Bank reference exchange rates.
About.dataMap: Map boundaries — Natural Earth (naturalearth.com) 110m land-polygon data, public domain, bundled with the site.
About.noAccountP1: There's nothing to sign up for. Your city list and preferences are saved locally in your own browser — see our Privacy Policy for details.
About.contactP1: Feedback or questions? See our Contact page.

Contact.introP1: World Time Zone doesn't have a support team yet — it's a small, independently run tool — but we do read messages sent to the address below.
Contact.useForP1: Bug reports, incorrect data for a city, privacy questions, or requests related to your rights under the LGPD or GDPR (see our Privacy Policy).
Contact.responseP1: This is a small project, so please allow a few days for a reply.
